svg.title: Ligconsolata Next Inherited Ligature Comparison
svg.desc: A real font outline comparison of upstream Inconsolata dlig ligatures and the current Ligconsolata Next shaping result.
svg.text: Legacy Inconsolata dlig outlines versus current Ligconsolata Next shaping.
左侧是上游 Inconsolata 原有 dlig，右侧是当前 Ligconsolata Next；用于检查 `=>` 等继承连字是否漂移。
Real outlines, same source / 真实轮廓，同一源码
dlig on, liga/calt off / 仅开 dlig
liga + dlig + calt on / 当前默认链路
Added in Next / Next 新增

g.text: Baseline: Inconsolata dlig / 基准 dlig
No Unicode substitutes / 不使用替代符号
